result:
I ran all 14 queries against the data files and each one returned a sensible answer. The queries are below.

Y1: 3. Y2: `["corp.io" "example.com" "mail.org"]`. Y3: 31.5. Y10: 333.77. The other answers are the maps and vectors the queries printed.

Y1 matched the profile with `query /profile/country ""`. I didn't test a user whose profile is null on its own, though the count came out without an error.

Y8 and Y9 split each line on spaces and use the third field as the service. I didn't check the log for blank lines.

Y13 splits each line on `=`, so a value that itself contains `=` would be cut short. No line in `env.txt` does.

Y1: get /data/users | filter ~(query /profile/country "" | lower | eq "de") | count
Y2: get /data/users | filter ~(query /email null | ne null) | map ~(get /email | split "@" | get /1 | lower) | distinct | sort
Y3: get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(query /profile/age null | type | eq ::number)) | map ~(get /profile/age) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
Y4: filter ~(get /status | eq "open") | map ~(query /assignee null | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(it)) | groupBy | map ~(count)
Y5: map ~(get {:id /id :n ~(query /comments [] | count)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /n | desc) /id]) | take 3 | map ~(get /id)
Y6: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | distinct | sort
Y7: get {:name /name :major ~(get /version | split "." | get /0 | toNumber) :depCount ~(get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(keys) | flat | distinct | count) :hasTest ~(get /scripts | has /test)}
Y8: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(get /2) | map ~(count)
Y9: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | anyOf (eq "WARN") (eq "ERROR")) | map ~(get /2) | distinct | sort
Y10: :rows (lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | map ~(split "," | get {:c /1 :q ~(get /3 | toNumber) :p ~(get /4 | toNumber) :s ~(get /5 | lower)})) | rows | filter ~(get /s | eq "paid") | map ~(mulOf /q /p) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
Y11: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | map ~(split "," | get {:c /1 :q ~(get /3 | toNumber) :s ~(get /5 | lower)}) | filter ~(get /s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(get /c) | map ~(map /q | sum) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /total | desc) /customer]) | take 2
Y12: get /services | entries | filter ~(get /1 | query /enabled true | ne false) | map ~(get [~(get /0) ~(get /1 | query /port null | if (eq null) ~(8080) ~(it))]) | toMap
Y13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") | map ~(split "=") | map ~(get [~(get /0 | trim | drop 3 | lower) ~(get /1 | trim)]) | toMap
Y14: "the Quick brown fox jumps over the quick Dog and the lazy dog Fox" | split " " | map ~(lower) | groupBy | map ~(count) | entries | map ~(get {:word ~(get /0 | toString) :count /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /count | desc) /word]) | take 3
